# eloquent-sqlite-conversions-tables

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities mapped with Eloquent 12, repositories and services, in PHP 8.4. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: sqlite.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch per field: absent, or a value that may be null.
- Transactions: the caller owns the transaction: nothing commits.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/Database.php             the connection of DATABASE_URL, which the models use
src/UnitOfWork.php           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/Tables/<Table>/          entity, repositories and service of each table
tests/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json           what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
composer install
vendor/bin/phpunit                                    # SQLite in memory
TEST_DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///app.db" vendor/bin/phpunit   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

final readonly class Page
{
    /** @param list<T> $items */
    public function __construct(public array $items, public int $total, public int $offset, public int $limit)
    {

    /**
     * The same page with every row turned into something else.

    public function map(callable $mapper): self

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A field of an update: absent (it keeps its value), or present with a value, which may be null.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Patch
{
    /** An absent field; use Patch::of() for one with a value. */
    public function __construct(public bool $isPresent = false, public mixed $value = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The field keeps its value.
     *
     * @return Patch<mixed>
     */
    public static function absent(): self
    {
        return new self();
    }

    /**
     * The field takes this value, which may be null.
     *
     * @template V
     * @param V $value
     * @return Patch<V>
     */
    public static function of(mixed $value): self
    {
        return new self(true, $value);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use Illuminate\Database\Capsule\Manager;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;

/** The database DATABASE_URL names, through Eloquent. It never migrates: the database already exists. */
final class Database
{
    public const DEFAULT_URL = 'sqlite:///app.db';

    /** The URL of DATABASE_URL, or the default one. */
    public static function url(): string
    {
        $url = getenv('DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : self::DEFAULT_URL;
    }

    /** A connection to the database at $url (DATABASE_URL when null); the models use it from then on. */
    public static function open(?string $url = null): Connection
    {
        $capsule = new Manager();
        $capsule->addConnection(self::config($url ?? self::url()));
        $capsule->bootEloquent();
        return $capsule->getConnection();
    }

    /**
     * The settings of the connection to a URL: postgresql://, mysql://, mariadb:// or sqlite:///<path> (sqlite:///:memory: for one in memory).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function config(string $url): array
    {
        if (str_starts_with($url, 'sqlite:')) {
            $path = substr($url, strlen('sqlite:///'));
            return ['driver' => 'sqlite', 'database' => $path !== '' ? $path : ':memory:', 'foreign_key_constraints' => true];
        }
        return ['url' => $url];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tables\Categories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on categories. It never commits: the caller owns the transaction. */
final class CategoryService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "categories" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Category $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['name'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('name', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('name', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 60) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('name', 'is longer than 60 characters');
            }
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Category', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Values that must be unique are not taken by another row.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function checkUnique(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Category $current): void
    {
        $name = array_key_exists('name', $values) ? $values['name'] : $current?->name;
        if ($name !== null) {
            $other = $uow->categories->findByName($name);
            if ($other !== null && ($current === null || $other->id != $current->id)) {
                throw new ConflictException('Category', 'name is already taken', ['name']);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Category $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
        self::checkUnique($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Category $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('name', $values)) {
            $entity->name = $values['name'];
        }
    }

    /** The Category with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, int $id): Category
    {
        return $uow->categories->findById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Category', $id);
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(CategoryChanges $changes): array
    {
        $values = [];
        if ($changes->name->isPresent) {
            $values['name'] = $changes->name->value;
        }
        return $values;
    }

    /** Stores a new Category after checking it. */
    public function createCategory(Category $category): Category
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'name' => $category->name,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values, $category): Category {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            return $uow->categories->insert($category);
        });
    }

    /** The Category with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getCategory(int $id): Category
    {
        return self::find($this->uow, $id);
    }

    /**
     * A page of categories, by primary key.
     *
     * @return Page<Category>
     */
    public function listCategories(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->categories->list($offset, $limit);
    }

    /** Changes the given values of a Category. */
    public function updateCategory(int $id, CategoryChanges $changes): Category
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): Category {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return $uow->categories->update($current);
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Category. */
    public function deleteCategory(int $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if ($uow->products->listByCategoryId($current->id) !== []) {
                throw new ConflictException('Category', 'rows of products still point to it', ['products']);
            }
            $uow->categories->delete($current);
        });
    }

    /** The Category with this name, or null. */
    public function findCategoryByName(string $name): ?Category
    {
        return $this->uow->categories->findByName($name);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tables\Categories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;

/** Keeps categories rows in the database, through its Eloquent model and the query builder, by every column of its key. Writes run in the transaction of whoever holds the connection, when there is one. */
final class SqlCategoryRepository implements CategoryRepository
{
    public function findById(int $id): ?Category
    {
        return Category::query()
            ->where('id', $id)
            ->first();
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $query = Category::query();
        $total = (clone $query)->count();
        $items = $query
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->offset($offset)
            ->limit($limit)
            ->get()
            ->all();
        return new Page($items, $total, $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function findByName(string $name): ?Category
    {
        return Category::query()
            ->where('name', $name)
            ->first();
    }

    public function insert(Category $entity): Category
    {
        $this->write(fn () => $entity->save());
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(Category $entity): Category
    {
        $changes = $entity->getDirty();
        if ($changes !== []) {
            $this->write(fn () => Category::query()
                ->where('id', $entity->getOriginal('id'))
                ->update($changes));
        }
        $entity->syncOriginal();
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(Category $entity): void
    {
        $this->write(fn () => Category::query()
            ->where('id', $entity->getOriginal('id'))
            ->delete());
        $entity->exists = false;
    }

    /** Runs a write; a database refusal (a unique value, a row still pointed to) becomes a ConflictException. */
    private function write(callable $change): void
    {
        try {
            $change();
        } catch (QueryException $error) {
            // SQLSTATE class 23: the change breaks a constraint
            if (!str_starts_with((string) $error->getCode(), '23')) {
                throw $error;
            }
            throw new ConflictException('Category', 'the database refused the change: ' . $error->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

    {
    }

     * Checks the values against the rules of the "products" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Product $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['categoryId'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('categoryId', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('category_id', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['name'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('name', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('name', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 100) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('name', 'is longer than 100 characters');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['price'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('price', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('price', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['status'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if (!$creating && array_key_exists('status', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('status', 'cannot be empty');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 10) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('status', 'is longer than 10 characters');
            }
            if (!in_array((string) $value, ['draft', 'live'], true)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('status', 'must be one of: draft, live');
            }
        }
        $categoryId = array_key_exists('categoryId', $values) ? $values['categoryId'] : $current?->category_id;
        if ($categoryId !== null && $uow->categories->findById($categoryId) === null) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError('category_id', 'no Category has this key');
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Product', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Product $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Product $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('categoryId', $values)) {
            $entity->category_id = $values['categoryId'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('name', $values)) {
            $entity->name = $values['name'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('price', $values)) {
            $entity->price = $values['price'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('status', $values)) {
            $entity->status = $values['status'];
        }
    }

    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field.

     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(ProductChanges $changes): array
    {
        $values = [];
        if ($changes->categoryId->isPresent) {
            $values['categoryId'] = $changes->categoryId->value;
        }
        if ($changes->name->isPresent) {
            $values['name'] = $changes->name->value;
        }
        if ($changes->price->isPresent) {
            $values['price'] = $changes->price->value;
        }
        if ($changes->status->isPresent) {
            $values['status'] = $changes->status->value;
        }
        return $values;
    }

    /** Stores a new Product after checking it. */
    public function createProduct(Product $product): Product
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'categoryId' => $product->category_id,
            'name' => $product->name,
            'price' => $product->price,
            'status' => $product->status,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values, $product): Product {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            return $uow->products->insert($product);
        });
    }

    /** The Product with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getProduct(int $id): Product
    {
        return self::find($this->uow, $id);
    }

    /**
     * A page of products, by primary key.
     *
     * @return Page<Product>
     */
    public function listProducts(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->products->list($offset, $limit);
    }

    /** Changes the given values of a Product. */
    public function updateProduct(int $id, ProductChanges $changes): Product
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): Product {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return $uow->products->update($current);
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Product. */
    public function deleteProduct(int $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if ($uow->productTags->listByProductId($current->id) !== []) {
                throw new ConflictException('Product', 'rows of product_tags still point to it', ['product_tags']);
            }
            $uow->products->delete($current);
        });
    }

    /**
     * The products with this category_id.
     *
     * @return list<Product>
     */
    public function listProductsByCategoryId(int $categoryId): array
    {
        return $this->uow->products->listByCategoryId($categoryId);
    }

    /** Links a Product and a Tag (product_tags). */
    public function addTag(int $productId, int $tagId): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($productId, $tagId): void {
            self::find($uow, $productId);
            if ($uow->tags->findById($tagId) === null) {
                throw new NotFoundException('Tag', $tagId);
            }
            if ($uow->productTags->findByProductIdAndTagId($productId, $tagId) !== null) {
                throw new ConflictException('Product', 'is already linked to this Tag', ['tagId']);
            }
            $link = new ProductTag();
            $link->product_id = $productId;
            $link->tag_id = $tagId;
            $uow->productTags->insert($link);
        });
    }

    /** Removes the link between a Product and a Tag (product_tags). */
    public function removeTag(int $productId, int $tagId): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($productId, $tagId): void {
            $link = $uow->productTags->findByProductIdAndTagId($productId, $tagId) ?? throw new NotFoundException('ProductTag', [$productId, $tagId]);
            $uow->productTags->delete($link);
        });
    }

        $this->write(fn () => $entity->save());
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(Tag $entity): Tag
    {
        $changes = $entity->getDirty();
        if ($changes !== []) {
            $this->write(fn () => Tag::query()
                ->where('id', $entity->getOriginal('id'))
                ->update($changes));
        }
        $entity->syncOriginal();
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(Tag $entity): void
    {
        $this->write(fn () => Tag::query()
            ->where('id', $entity->getOriginal('id'))
            ->delete());
        $entity->exists = false;
    }

    /** Runs a write; a database refusal (a unique value, a row still pointed to) becomes a ConflictException. */
    private function write(callable $change): void
    {
        try {
            $change();
        } catch (QueryException $error) {
            // SQLSTATE class 23: the change breaks a constraint
            if (!str_starts_with((string) $error->getCode(), '23')) {
                throw $error;
            }
            throw new ConflictException('Tag', 'the database refused the change: ' . $error->getMessage());
        }
    }

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tables\Tags;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\Tables\ProductTags\ProductTag;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on tags. It never commits: the caller owns the transaction. */
final class TagService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "tags" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Tag $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['label'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('label', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('label', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 30) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('label', 'is longer than 30 characters');
            }
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Tag', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Tag $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Tag $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('label', $values)) {
            $entity->label = $values['label'];
        }
    }

    /** The Tag with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, int $id): Tag
    {
        return $uow->tags->findById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Tag', $id);
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(TagChanges $changes): array
    {
        $values = [];
        if ($changes->label->isPresent) {
            $values['label'] = $changes->label->value;
        }
        return $values;
    }

    /** Stores a new Tag after checking it. */
    public function createTag(Tag $tag): Tag
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'label' => $tag->label,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values, $tag): Tag {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            return $uow->tags->insert($tag);
        });
    }

    /** The Tag with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getTag(int $id): Tag
    {
        return self::find($this->uow, $id);
    }

    /**
     * A page of tags, by primary key.
     *
     * @return Page<Tag>
     */
    public function listTags(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->tags->list($offset, $limit);
    }

    /** Changes the given values of a Tag. */
    public function updateTag(int $id, TagChanges $changes): Tag
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): Tag {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return $uow->tags->update($current);
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Tag. */
    public function deleteTag(int $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if ($uow->productTags->listByTagId($current->id) !== []) {
                throw new ConflictException('Tag', 'rows of product_tags still point to it', ['product_tags']);
            }
            $uow->tags->delete($current);
        });
    }

    /** Links a Tag and a Product (product_tags). */
    public function addProduct(int $tagId, int $productId): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($tagId, $productId): void {
            self::find($uow, $tagId);
            if ($uow->products->findById($productId) === null) {
                throw new NotFoundException('Product', $productId);
            }
            if ($uow->productTags->findByProductIdAndTagId($productId, $tagId) !== null) {
                throw new ConflictException('Tag', 'is already linked to this Product', ['productId']);
            }
            $link = new ProductTag();
            $link->tag_id = $tagId;
            $link->product_id = $productId;
            $uow->productTags->insert($link);
        });
    }

    /** Removes the link between a Tag and a Product (product_tags). */
    public function removeProduct(int $tagId, int $productId): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($tagId, $productId): void {
            $link = $uow->productTags->findByProductIdAndTagId($productId, $tagId) ?? throw new NotFoundException('ProductTag', [$productId, $tagId]);
            $uow->productTags->delete($link);
        });
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Database;
use App\SqlUnitOfWork;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Builder;

/** The test database: TEST_DATABASE_URL, or SQLite in memory, with every table created empty for every test. */
final class TestDatabase
{
    public static function url(): ?string
    {
        $url = getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : null;
    }

    /** The repositories over the test database, with every table dropped and created again. */
    public static function open(): SqlUnitOfWork
    {
        $db = Database::open(self::url() ?? 'sqlite:///:memory:');
        $schema = $db->getSchemaBuilder();
        $schema->dropAllTables();
        self::createTables($schema);
        return new SqlUnitOfWork($db);
    }

    /** Every table as the database has it, parents first. */
    private static function createTables(Builder $schema): void
    {
        $schema->create('customers', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('id', true);
            $table->string('email', 120);
            $table->text('password_hash');
            $table->dateTimeTz('created_at')->useCurrent();
            $table->unique(['email']);
        });

        $schema->create('categories', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->integer('id', true);
            $table->string('name', 60);
            $table->unique(['name']);
        });

        $schema->create('products', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('id', true);
            $table->integer('category_id');
            $table->string('name', 100);
            $table->decimal('price', 10, 2);
            $table->string('status', 10)->default('draft');
            $table->foreign(['category_id'])->references(['id'])->on('categories');
            // CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'live')): the schema builder has no CHECK constraints
        });

        $schema->create('tags', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->integer('id', true);
            $table->string('label', 30);
        });

        $schema->create('product_tags', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('product_id');
            $table->integer('tag_id');
            $table->primary(['product_id', 'tag_id']);
            $table->foreign(['product_id'])->references(['id'])->on('products');
            $table->foreign(['tag_id'])->references(['id'])->on('tags');
        });
    }
}
